prompt: Monumental immersive museum installation, absolute darkness, single powerful projector behind camera. Enormous floor to ceiling white velvet curtain pooling onto floor. Gigantic black and white portrait of Salvador Dalí projected seamlessly across curtain. Centered below, young woman seen from behind gently parts curtain, opening narrow slit into complete blackness. Oversized white poplin shirt, ultra wide black trousers, minimalist Scandinavian fashion. Projected portrait naturally wraps across her back, shirt, and hair like real projection mapping. Authentic projector light spill, subtle volumetric haze, floating dust, perfect symmetry, monumental scale, minimalist architecture. Documentary museum photography, architectural fine art, ultra photorealistic, award winning.
